1.w: Benjamin was the father of Bela, his firstborn; Ashbel was born second, Aharah third,

3.w: Bela’s sons were Addar, Gera, Abihud,

6.w: These were the descendants of Ehud who were leaders of the families living in Geba who were forced to move to Manahath:

7.w: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who moved them. Gera was the father of Uzzah and Ahihud.

8.w: Shaharaim fathered sons in Moab after he divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.

9.w: By his wife Hodesh he fathered Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malkam,

10.w: Jeuz, Sakia, and Mirmah. These were his sons; they were family leaders.

11.w: By Hushim he fathered Abitub and Elpaal.

12.w: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod, as well as its surrounding towns),

13.w: Beriah, and Shema. They were leaders of the families living in Aijalon and chased out the inhabitants of Gath.

16.w: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.

18.w: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.

21.w: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.

25.w: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.

27.w: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zikri were the sons of Jeroham.

28.w: These were the family leaders listed in the genealogical records; they lived in Jerusalem.

29.w: The father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon; his wife’s name was Maacah.

30.w: His firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

32.w: Mikloth was the father of Shimeah. They also lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

33.w: Ner was the father of Kish, and Kish was the father of Saul. Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

34.w: The son of Jonathan: Meribbaal. Meribbaal was the father of Micah.

35.w: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

36.w: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, and Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza,

37.w: and Moza was the father of Binea. His son was Raphah, whose son was Eleasah, whose son was Azel.

38.w: Azel had six sons: Azrikam his firstborn, followed by Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

39.w: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam was his firstborn, Jeush second, and Eliphelet third.

40.w: The sons of Ulam were warriors who were adept archers. They had many sons and grandsons, a total of 150. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.
